layout_rules: All four announcement cards use the supplied angular comic reference composition.
Each card uses a solid near black tinted background: IMPORTANT #050000, NOTICE #02091B, REMINDER #070300, ANNOUNCEMENT #010703.
The 14px outer accent frame has clipped upper left and lower right corners and grows with the rendered message.
The top left MODGLOW wordmark, two slanted header panels, icon tile, title and three accent slashes share fixed geometry across all four flairs.
IMPORTANT uses red #F20D24, NOTICE uses blue #087CFF, REMINDER uses orange #FF7900, and ANNOUNCEMENT uses lime #7CFF00.
IMPORTANT and NOTICE use cream title panels. REMINDER and ANNOUNCEMENT use their accent colour for the title panel.
Body text begins at x=145 and y=350 with 64px IBM Plex Sans and 78px line spacing.
The body marker begins at x=96 and tracks the final wrapped line.
Wrapping uses conservative glyph width estimates, including wider lowercase m and w, and splits oversized unbroken tokens.
SVG height is derived from the final rendered line count and preserves at least 32px between the text bounds and the inner bottom edge of the frame.
The renderer rejects empty content, content above 2600 characters, and content above 24 rendered lines.
All fills and strokes are solid. No gradients, blends, opacity, filters, glow, shadows, textures or extra badges are used.
XML text is escaped and fonts are bundled. System fonts are disabled during rasterization.
Listing artwork is not presented as a screenshot of the live app.
note: The live SVG renderer is the source of truth. The reference sample SVG is kept in sync with its fixed geometry, palettes and minimum canvas size.
